name: The Tinder Date from Hell
win_condition: Leave with Chill remaining and avoid becoming Charmed, Ghosted, or publicly humiliated.
loss_condition: Hit 0 Chill, pay for everything, or accidentally agree to brunch tomorrow.
setup_text: They looked better in the photos, which is an ambitious sentence because the photos were already a war crime.
gm_notes: Use a cramped venue and force close-range play. Great for teaching Uncomfortable, Doubt, and Hard Pass outcomes.

name: The Mansplaining Tech Bro
win_condition: Publicly expose the flaw in his explanation or outlast his interruptions.
loss_condition: Fail three INT-based checks in a row and the whole table assumes he was right.
setup_text: The cloud, apparently, is something he personally invented in 2016.
gm_notes: Best run with allies present so interruption and positioning matter.

name: The Karen in the Wild
win_condition: Protect the staff, survive the screeching, and prevent a manager escalation spiral.
loss_condition: Let the scene go viral in her favor or lose all public goodwill in the room.
setup_text: She has mistaken your existence for poor customer service.
gm_notes: Track nearby NPC morale. This encounter teaches Social Capital and crowd sway.

name: The Last Functioning Outlet Heist
win_condition: Secure 10 uninterrupted minutes of power before the laptop hits zero.
loss_condition: The device dies mid-objective, Heat +1, and somebody else claims the socket by buying a single espresso.
setup_text: The only outlet in the cafe has a three-way adapter, two enemy chargers, and the aura of a religious relic.
gm_notes: Run a 4-segment battery clock. Let players win through stealthy cable routing, public shame, bribing Barista Kyle, or pretending the fire code is on their side.

name: Visa Counter Speedrun
win_condition: Get the stamp, number, or appointment confirmation before the counter closes.
loss_condition: Lose the queue position, gain Heat +1, or accept a stamped document with the wrong name.
setup_text: The official has the stamp. The printer has chosen violence. The queue has become a small nation with laws nobody voted on.
gm_notes: Keep the why simple and the choices immediate: appeal to procedure, expose a queue cheat, trade a favor, or sprint for a missing copy.

name: The Group Chat Trial
win_condition: Restore context before the thread decides the party is cringe beyond appeal.
loss_condition: A screenshot wins without context, one ally Ghosts the group, and the thread becomes Misinformation for the next session.
setup_text: A message from last night has been screenshotted, cropped, captioned, and given a life coach's confidence.
gm_notes: Make this a courtroom in a phone: three evidence reveals, two hostile reactions, one chance to mute the thread before it mutates.

name: The QR Code Menu of Doom
win_condition: Find the real WiFi password hidden behind the cafe's menu, decor, and Barista Kyle's patience.
loss_condition: The party orders the wrong thing, fails to connect, and owes money for a deconstructed toast nobody wanted.
setup_text: The QR menu opens six tabs, the specials board is written in chalk sarcasm, and Kyle keeps glancing at the plant wall like it knows too much.
gm_notes: Use three interchangeable clues: receipt phrase, wall-art cipher, and Kyle's clue-for-patience trade. Any two point to the password; all three earn the trust token.

name: The 5-Star Review Tribunal
win_condition: Convince, distract, or outmaneuver the Karen before she posts a venue-killing review.
loss_condition: The review lands first, staff morale collapses, and the party gets blamed in the replies.
setup_text: The restaurant's rating ticks from 4.6 to 4.5 in real time, and everyone in the room somehow knows it.
gm_notes: Prep the situation, not the verdict: appeal to fairness, protect the staff, redirect the crowd, or turn the review into a joke before it becomes law.

name: Rooftop Ring Light Eclipse
win_condition: Save the creator event from becoming a live-streamed lighting disaster.
loss_condition: The sponsor leaves, the best light dies, and the party becomes the backup content.
setup_text: The sunset is perfect for exactly twelve minutes, which is unfortunate because the ring lights have started smoking.
gm_notes: Make the room move: VIP booth, bar line, photo wall, and emergency balcony. Each zone offers a different solution and a different way to look ridiculous.

name: The Pitch Deck Funeral
win_condition: Deliver one coherent pitch before the room realizes every slide is from a different reality.
loss_condition: The investors applaud politely, which is worse than booing, and the deck becomes a cautionary LinkedIn post.
setup_text: The founder says the deck is 'basically final,' then opens a folder named FINAL_final_ACTUAL_use_this_v7.
gm_notes: Let players solve with engineering, charisma, sabotage, or radical honesty. The funny part is that any of those might work.

name: Coworking Coup Opening Night
win_condition: Keep the regulars organized long enough to block the Corporate Machine's takeover announcement.
loss_condition: The lease clock advances, regular morale drops, and the best conference room becomes enterprise-only.
setup_text: The new owners promise 'community-first synergy' while quietly removing the free coffee and labeling beanbags as premium collaboration pods.
gm_notes: Track three clocks: Corporate Lease, Regular Morale, Printer Mutiny. Every win should improve one and complicate another.

name: Friday Night Fyre Lite
win_condition: Survive until the boat arrives, expose the fake sponsor, or become the new organizers by accident.
loss_condition: The party runs out of Chill, water, or credibility and wakes up tagged in promotional material.
setup_text: The beach mixer has no stage, no shade, no confirmed artist, and a banner that misspells both 'exclusive' and the island.
gm_notes: Use resource pressure instead of a map: Chill, water, battery, clout, and shade. Offer three endings: rescue, expose, or monetize.

name: The Podcast Guest No One Can Leave
win_condition: Complete the episode without revealing a secret, losing the sponsor, or being trapped in a bonus Patreon segment.
loss_condition: The host gets the soundbite, the sponsor leaves, and the party's worst take becomes a clip.
setup_text: The host says 'quick question' with the tone of a landlord holding a security deposit.
gm_notes: Run timed segments: cold open, sponsor read, caller betrayal, emergency ad break, final plug. The ad break can function as a short rest if earned.

name: DevCon AI Keynote Doom Loop
win_condition: Prove the keynote is synthetic, redirect the crowd, or make the demo fail in a way that looks intentional.
loss_condition: The AI gets a standing ovation, the party is called anti-innovation, and the venue sells their likeness as a case study.
setup_text: The keynote speaker has used the same founder anecdote three times and somehow remembers a Q&A that has not happened yet.
gm_notes: Use a clue net: badge logs, repeated anecdote, impossible memory. The finale is a public debate or demo sabotage, not a scripted reveal.

name: Club Cartel Guest List Infiltration
win_condition: Get a name onto the guest list, steal the real list, or flip the door crew without starting a bottle-service war.
loss_condition: The party gets bounced, photographed, and charged for a table they never sat at.
setup_text: The guest list is protected by a clipboard, a velvet rope, and the ancient spell 'who do you know here?'
gm_notes: Offer parallel routes: dance floor, door negotiation, backchannel DMs, VIP booth. Let each route create a different kind of Heat.
